runtimeMapping.sourceTargets: All ordinary modes select CAST0 one legal WALK enemy in original 1-1; original Attack event .267 or charged Attack_2 .4 at min(1.1,ASPD/100).
runtimeMapping.clone: Original token stat keyframes at owner elite/level, selected distinct sktok rank, its own independent HP/cooldown; source E2 RESPAWN_TIME ADDITION -10. Talent1 PHASE1 gate, slot1/MELEE/facing/HealFree; finish recharges stock1 and starts its independent redeployment timer. Owner finish kills active clone.
runtimeMapping.skill1: Native attribute-scale component MAX_HP x selected hp_ratio supplies dynamic physical-only shield, selected duration10. Evade physical selected probability; Arts/TRUE never consume physical shield.
runtimeMapping.skill2: Source phatom_s_2 creates selected times stacks ATK MULTIPLIER, source ON_AFTER_OUTPUT_DAMAGE consumes one per accepted output, including shield-absorbed output; canceled/dodged hits do not consume. Last charged attack uses Attack_2 and switch_mode_after_attack restores normal clip after it.
runtimeMapping.skill3: Source action RandomCastAbility chooses one of sluggish/stun/root for all uncapped legal WALK x4 victims; owner/clone Born alias Skill original .433 event emits selected Physical pulse plus relative push and status. Source canUseInAbnormalState1 retained. Separate owner/clone draws.
runtimeMapping.assets: Both token facings resolved by original animator/SkeletonDataAsset/AtlasAsset/Material PPtrs, not same-name object lookup; raw skeletons unchanged.

verificationLimits: Original C# OnBornSkill/action dispatcher was not recovered. The literal Born→Skill event binds deployment damage to .433; normal-attack reentry and action callback frame ordering use a recorded simulation clock rather than certified native frame parity.
RandomCastAbility serializes three branches with no weights; simulation samples one uniformly. Original client random generator, draw ordering and exact probability dispatcher were not recovered.

RechargeToken ON_FINISH versus independent redeploy clock is mapped to cooldown from clone removal; exact token cooldown persistence through owner withdrawal/redeployment remains a recorded implementation contract, not executable C# recovery.
Source attribute MULTIPLIER uses existing percent aggregation; native external aggregation dispatcher is unrecovered.
Original Unity particle/audio effects are retained as identifiers only; no replacement effects fabricated.
